description: Read the output of `./gradlew <tasks> --dry-run` (or of a real build with --console=plain) and return the task order with each task's project, status (UP-TO-DATE, FROM-CACHE, NO-SOURCE, FAILED…) and its Maven equivalent. A build.gradle is code, so the task graph cannot be known without running Gradle: --dry-run computes it without executing anything. Note that Gradle interleaves tasks of different projects; Maven builds module by module.
name: gradle_plan
